ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 90
   D. 42

6. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 17

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 10
   C. 81
   D. 9

9. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 48

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 66

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

12. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 5

13. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

15. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

16. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

17. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

18. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

19. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

21. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

23. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

25. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

26. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

27. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 29
   D. 28

28. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

29. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

30. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21
